messages:
Priya: thinking about a small, pragmatic approach for protocol mismatches we keep hitting (gRPC <-> JSON). idea: protocol policy on each route + a lightweight proto/json linter.
Priya: policy example: `protocol_policy: { prefer: "grpc", fallback: "json", allow_transcode: true }`
Ben: nice. policy should be editable in Console per-route and exportable via infra-as-code.
Marta: linter + CI check would catch mismatch classes that cause gRPC-web 415s. also would help customers migrating to proto-first.
Chris: perf note: auto-transcode adds ~3ms p95 and an alloc per-request in current env (small but visible on tail-sensitive routes). we should gate `allow_transcode` by default-off on routes with p95 < 50ms SLO.
Priya: agreed. Console UX: surface a badge on route list "protocol: grpc (json fallback)" and a diagnostics pill with lint warnings and suggested fixes.
Ben: suggested telemetry: `protocol_selected`, `protocol_fallback_count`, `transcode_latency_p95`, `proto_mismatch_lint_count`. add tenant-scoped dimensions.
Marta: test plan: unit linter rules + infra/protocol-e2e that runs against real shims (gRPC-web client, envoy transcode) + a smoke job in CI to prevent regressions.
Priya: local dev command: `tools/protolint run ./proto --route-mapping=routes.yaml --out=diagnostics.json`
Priya: sample linter output:
```
ERROR route /v1/generate: response.choices (proto repeated) != response.choices (json object)
Hint: change json mapping to array or mark proto field as `map<string,Choice>`
Severity: high
```
Chris: rollout plan: feature-flag `route_protocol_policy_v1` in Console. start 5% tenants, monitor `protocol_fallback_count` and `transcode_latency_p95` for 48h, then 25%, then global. provide an override to force `fallback: none` for enterprises.
devops-bot: deploy:protolint-canary queued (canary=3 nodes) :hourglass:
Ben: can we add a quick-fix action in Console to auto-generate a JSON mapping suggestion (proto->json) and a preview of the marshalled payload? would reduce manual back-and-forth.
Marta: yes, preview + diff view (proto message vs json example) would be huge for support. also include a link to run provisional lint check against a sample payload.
Chris: ops concern: metrics cardinality if we tag by route + tenant + protocol. limit to route buckets + tenant tier. aggregate fine-grained in short retention only.
Priya: good point. keep high-cardinality metrics ephemeral and export aggregated counts to long-term store.
Ben: docs: update SDK quickstarts: browser SDK defaults to JSON and will autodetect gRPC support; server SDKs prefer gRPC. add migration guide.
Priya: I'll sketch an RFC (design + rollout + telemetry + QA) and a minimal protolint prototype in Go. will ping reviewers when ready.
Marta: +1. I'll start Console mockups for the badge + diagnostics card and drop them in #design.
Ben: I'll prep CI gates and the infra/protocol-e2e harness changes.
Chris: will add telemetry dashboards (short-term) and a canary alert if `protocol_fallback_count` spikes > 3x baseline during rollout.
Priya: thanks — posting RFC link shortly and tagging folks for review.
